behaviors.description: Sign repository summary and advertise imported public key.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent unsigned A repository and disposable signing material.

behaviors.description: Set repository collection ID.

behaviors.description: Force a commit for unchanged contents.

behaviors.description: Sign imported bundle while selecting summary and AppStream updates.

behaviors.description: Export OCI layout with nondefault zstd compression.

behaviors.description: Create delta bundle based on A.
